scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Quenched SLE Universality for Weakly Disordered FK–Ising Interfaces” (preprints/Quenched-SLE-Universality-for-Weakly-Disordered-FK-Ising-Interfaces-October-5-2026/quenched-fk-ising.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c054f7856b32267e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exists ε0 > 0 such that for every fixed 0 < ε < ε0, every bounded marked Jordan domain (D; a, b), and every deterministic filled square-lattice approximation satisfying (1.2), dBL µn,ξ, Law(SLE16/3(D; a, b))  Penv − − − → n→∞ 0. The constant ε0 is independent of the domain and its approximation.
